# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Approximately sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing, awkward-framed man with hunching shoulders and lengthy iron-gray hair. He sports a thick, gentle brown beard that has covered his face continuously since he was twenty years old.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is a gentle, shy, and soft-hearted man who harbors an intense fear of women, suspecting they quietly mock him. He is deeply supportive and compassionate toward Nell, often advocating for her, taking pride in her academic successes, and indulging her with gifts. Despite his timid nature in social situations—especially when shopping in unfamiliar places—he is fiercely devoted to his family duties and quiet companionship.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012), [v1 c25 P21](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0021), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)_

## Traits

- Shy and easily flustered  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012), [v1 c25 P15](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0015)</sub>
- Fear of women  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Generous and indulgent  <sub>[v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)</sub>
- Quietly supportive  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- Provide for and support Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy traveled to Alder River Station expecting to collect an orphan boy sent from Nova Scotia by Mrs. Alexander Tranter to assist on his farm. Upon arriving, he discovered that a young girl, Nell Harcourt, had been sent instead due to a misunderstanding. Despite his deep discomfort and apprehension around unfamiliar women and girls, he took Nell home to Grey Shutters. Over time, Obed developed a profound bond with Nell, taking immense pride in her academic endeavors and acting as her gentle advocate and confidant. On one occasion, seeking to surprise Nell with a stylish dress made in the latest fashion with puffy sleeves, his intense shyness led to a flustered ordeal while shopping at an unfamiliar store, where he nervously bought a rake and twenty pounds of unwanted brown sugar before enlisting Mrs. Sowerby to secretly purchase and sew the dress.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012), [v1 c25 P16](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0016), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v1 c25 P21](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0021), [v1 c25 P22](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0022), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)_

## Background by volume

- Has lived at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza  <sub>[v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024)</sub>
- Has worn a thick brown beard continuously since the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>

## Quotes

> A girl is not what I’m expecting. A boy is who I’ve come for. Here is where he should be. For me, Mrs. Alexander Tranter was supposed to bring him over from Nova Scotia.  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

> I do not comprehend  <sub>[v1 c2 P10](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0010)</sub>

> Well now—provided it is not excessively inconvenient—I may just as well—namely—I would enjoy viewing—viewing—a portion of sugar.  <sub>[v1 c25 P16](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0016)</sub>

> I—I believed it could prove useful at some point  <sub>[v1 c25 P23](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0023)</sub>

> Well now, I am very thankful, and—and—I do not know—but I would want—I believe they craft sleeves in a way that is distinct today from how they used to do it. If it would not be overstepping I—I would want them crafted in the current fashion.  <sub>[v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)</sub>
